title:
A reference to an external image to be rendered in-place.

Note that C3 AI Suite Markdown supports image sizes using a `@` suffix to the #src (destination):
```md
![title](path/file.png@200x150)
```
If a size suffix is used, the at sign and `x` are required, but either width or height may be omitted; both `@500x`
(width only) and `@x500` (height only) are valid. _There must be no whitespace in the src._

For example, this is an SVG image with no specific size (and a large view box):
![tiny](doc/img/logo.svg@8x)
![small](doc/img/logo.svg@x16)
![large](doc/img/logo.svg@32x32)

```md
![tiny](doc/img/logo.svg@8x)
![small](doc/img/logo.svg@x16)
![large](doc/img/logo.svg@32x32)
```
